offering_description.value: Makes chlorine, caustic soda and epoxy materials and sells ammunition. Chemicals go to manufacturers and water utilities, while ammunition goes to retailers, consumers and government agencies, produced in its own plants.

primary_products.value: chlorine; caustic soda; epoxy resins; hydrochloric acid; ammunition

customer_segment.value: B2B: chemical manufacturers, water utilities, pulp and paper mills, construction suppliers; B2C: sport shooters and hunters buying ammunition through retailers; B2G: defense and government agencies buying ammunition

end_markets.value: water treatment; pulp and paper; construction; automotive; defense; sporting and hunting

revenue_model.value: product sales: chemicals and ammunition sold to industrial, retail and government customers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: makes chemicals and ammunition in its own plants, sold to industrial and retail customers; brand owner: sells ammunition under its own Winchester brand through retail channels

geography_served.value: global: plants in the US and Europe, sales to customers in North America, Europe and other regions

specialization.value: diversified: chlor alkali and vinyls, epoxy, and Winchester ammunition as separate businesses with different customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: industrial chemical customers and government contracts; distributors / dealers: chemical distributors and ammunition wholesalers; third-party retail: sporting goods stores and gun shops selling ammunition
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; third-party retail

regulatory_exposure.value: high: federal licensing to manufacture ammunition, plus EPA and OSHA rules for chlorine and chemical plants
